answer: For agents trading lagoon, karst and dune maps, allocate voting weight per gigabyte of proven storage, with no per-account bonus. Encode every pledged replica with its account key using a slow transform. Unpredictable spot checks have deadlines shorter than reconstruction time, so aliases cannot all answer from one shared copy. More voting weight requires storing additional replicas and paying disk rent. The encoding must resist deduplication and cheap on-demand reconstruction; identity labels alone add no weight.
